'''Grasping tentacles''' were [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manipulators. The [[Doom Slayer]], an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] created by [[Sythluss Leethe]] had two retractable grasping tentacles that it could use to attack its targets and manipulate objects.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
